description: The Project for the Rehabilitation of 14 Bridges Damaged by the Cyclone 'Ditwah'
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The People's Republic of China has agreed to provide a financial assistance for the implementation of a project to rehabilitate 14 bridges in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Northwestern, North Central and Eastern provinces that were damaged by the Cyclone 'Ditwah'. The said project has been planned to be implemented in two stages and 09 bridges will be rehabilitated under its first stage within a period of 18 months. The People's Republic of China is set to provide a grant of RMB 79 million for the relevant rehabilitation work. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to sign the Agreement between the Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development and the People's Republic of China for the implementation of the said Project and to declare the Project as a specific project of the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.
